name: token-pie
description: Local, machine-wide visibility into GitHub Copilot token and AI-credit spend.
author: Ashish Koshy

commands.title: Token Pie: Enable Local Trace Collection
Token Pie: Purge Retained Prompt Content

tokenPie.refreshIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to poll `agent-traces.db` for new spans.

tokenPie.creditsPerNanoAiu.markdownDescription: Conversion from `copilot_usage_nano_aiu` to AI Credits. **Calibrate against your GitHub billing dashboard before trusting absolute figures.**

tokenPie.statusBar.enabled.description: Show today's spend in the status bar.

tokenPie.autoPurge.enabled.markdownDescription: After each ingest, delete the model output and tool schemas that `github.copilot.chat.otel.maxAttributeSizeChars` cannot suppress. This is the only case where Token Pie writes to Copilot's database. Measured at under 3 ms in steady state; a locked database is skipped, not waited on.

tokenPie.rateCard.autoUpdate.markdownDescription: Once a week, fetch a newer copy of GitHub's published model prices from `tokenPie.rateCard.url`. The extension ships a dated snapshot and works offline without this; the fetch only keeps the *comparison* against your measured rates current. Set to `false` for no outbound requests.

tokenPie.rateCard.url.markdownDescription: Where the weekly refresh reads published prices from. Point this at your own file if you are on negotiated or enterprise pricing; the format is the bundled `rate-card.json`. A response that does not parse as a complete rate card is discarded rather than partly applied. Settable in user settings only: the refresh runs unattended on a timer, so a workspace that could repoint it would be choosing a host for you.

tokenPie.rateCard.models.markdownDescription: A rate card supplied inline, overriding both the bundled snapshot and any fetched copy. Same shape as `rate-card.json`. Use this to price a model GitHub does not publish, or to correct one.

tokenPie.minCreditsWorthMentioning.markdownDescription: Nothing worth less than this many credits is reported, however it scores on the rules below. _The one materiality question only you can answer: what is too small to be worth your attention. Raise it to be told less, lower it to be told more._

tokenPie.warnAtDaysLeft.markdownDescription: Warn when the allowance has fewer than this many days of slack left. _How much warning you want is a decision about your own week, not something the data can settle. One heavy day changes the answer at two._

tokenPie.dailyBudget.markdownDescription: A daily spending budget, as a percent of the whole allowance. Zero means pace yourself to the reset instead. _Zero by default because a budget already exists without being set: what remains, divided by the days left, is the pace that lasts. A figure here is a stricter promise you are making to yourself._

tokenPie.historyDays.markdownDescription: How far back transcripts are read, and how long rollups are kept. _One monthly billing period plus slack. Longer costs a slower first scan._
